edits.before: Q through two units on every last-hit — each stack is permanent AP; the lane is a savings account from level 1.
edits.after: Vladimir pays health for every Transfusion and can't answer poke — Q him on each last-hit and stack for free.

edits.before: W on cage-stunned or rooted targets only — uncaged Dark Matter is a donation to his dodge stats.
edits.after: At 2 he still has no answer — a cage means a free W-auto trade every time he steps up to farm.

edits.before: Primordial Burst online — anyone under half is now a math problem with one answer. Count R damage out loud.
edits.after: At 6 Sanguine Pool dodges your cage and combo while Hemoplague tanks the rest — bait the pool before spending.

edits.before: Luden's spike: cage-W-Q-R deletes squishies who touch the wall. Your zone is a courtroom now.
edits.after: Luden's reopens the kill: with Pool down (28-16s), one cage still one-combos him before his heal ramps.

edits.before: Late Veigar IS the scaling argument: cage the choke, burst the carry, and let infinite AP write the closing statement.
edits.after: Two-plus items his spellvamp, Hemoplague amp and Pool immunity outlast your burst — cage his carries, not him.

edits.before: Vladimir wins by landing Sanguine Pool, denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Vladimir wins by pooling your cage, out-sustaining every trade with Transfusion, and amping teamfights with Hemoplague.

edits.before: - Vladimir Sanguine Pool: matchup-defining — Untargetable dodge — bait it before you spend your kill window. Count it out loud if you must. - Your E Event Horizon (self-cage) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Sanguine Pool (W) is 28s at rank 1, 16s max — untargetable for 2s; bait it before you spend the combo, then he has no dodge for nearly half a minute. - Transfusion falls to 4.6s max, so long trades feed his sustain — buy Grievous Wounds early into it.

edits.before: Cage his step-up, W the edge-stun, Q-auto, and walk — a half-bar trade that also deposited three stacks into the curve.
edits.after: Cage the path to his Transfusion range — when he clips the edge, W-Q lands free and he pays health just to answer you.

edits.before: W-ing open ground on a moving target and trading uncaged 'just to stack' — Veigar without the wall is a piggy bank with a hat.
edits.after: His Tides of Blood clears on a 13s-to-5s cooldown while he heals off your wave — a shove war just feeds his sustain race.
